scope: Native LoRaWAN DD + predeclared DDL sensitivity, independent semantic audit, conventional point-to-upper-radius calibration, and bounded state/metric controls. Not full external notebook/paper replication. No new localizer design.

native_configuration.preprocessing: source cell 1 sentinel -200 replaced with int(min(after training sentinel->0)-1), training-only value; validation/test same value
native_configuration.DD: M1 on train1; DD on train2 predicting M1 positional errors
native_configuration.DDL: same DD labels, append fixed M1 predicted latitude/longitude to features
native_configuration.source_statements: assignment and fit/predict statements selected verbatim from cells 5 and 7; original definition bodies for metric helpers; notebook reporting, tuning, NN comparisons, Keras and plotting not executed

execution_environment.parallel_backend: joblib sequential backend, source model n_jobs parameter remains 2; deterministic scheduling, not a new tree parameter

metric.compatibility: haversine package unavailable; explicit scalar haversine implementation injected into unchanged expanded helper definitions. Independent pyproj.Geod spherical geodesic oracle. This is a disclosed metric dependency substitution, not installation of the original library or certification of its historical version.

roles.primary_calibration: validation groups that do not intersect either native model-training half
roles.primary_evaluation: test groups intersecting neither native training nor the complete original validation population
roles.group_definition: transitive union of raw CSV original-serialization key (RX Time,SF,HDOP 2 decimals,sorted nonreception-excluded RSSI) or baseline content key (EPSG32631 x/y rounded .001m, lexically sorted BS/RSSI pairs with .001dB quantization), across all 55,375 retained source rows
roles.policy: No policy tuning. Fixed threshold grid is descriptive, not a deployment target. Native-all case summaries are retained as secondary outputs.

calibration.rank: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) with Decimal arithmetic; +inf if rank exceeds n
calibration.constant_control: same calibration cases, kth actual_error order statistic
calibration.interpretation: Rank theorem is conditional on exchangeability; source has within-route dependence and adaptive history. Measurements here are empirical, not independent deployment guarantees or conditional accepted-risk guarantees.

endpoints.coverage: inclusive actual_error <= radius; strict original overestimation reported separately
endpoints.accepted: finite radius <= tau AND integrity certified
endpoints.denominators: all source test requests, scored primary test requests, accepted cases explicitly separate
endpoints.curve_grid: [0] + logspace(0,4,201); endpoints descriptive, no test-driven threshold choice

source_expression_audit.signed_plot: source cell35 e-abs(e-DDL), displayed DD; correct reference e-DDL; source first two labels swapped. Evaluate validation/test separately, test application is a new controlled audit not an original published test figure.
source_expression_audit.selection_axis: source cell23 nonempty prefixes 1..n-1 plotted at 100*(k-1)/(n-1); compare 100*k/n and restore n endpoint. No published figure claim.

controls.information: strong conventional and integrated routes have identical model hashes, row/feature handles, metric references, role evidence and calibration values; no superiority inferred from equal results
controls.oracle: metric checks using true transmitter labels are offline evaluation checks only; not deployment detectors
controls.actual_model_shift: none this stage: stale position-model case tests a declared identity change without asserting a numerical changed-model effect

stop_conditions: No outcome-based source, scenario, threshold, seed, or model selection
Any native/independent disagreement above fixed numerical tolerance pauses affected results
No inference that source native DAE claimed a calibrated upper bound
Original files, G1 core, R1 documents and public releases unchanged
